title: USS Nautilus fitted with a side hatch to grab discs

tellings.quote: thing that um that we did is we had like this we created this hatch this side hatch to be able to acquire objects that were uh discs uh unknown unknown objects um in the ocean

plain: Between 1963 and 1966, the story goes, the Navy submarine USS Nautilus was fitted with a special side hatch so it could pick up discs and other unknown objects from the ocean. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells Michels this second hand. He passes on what a named person told him and points to the International UFO Congress, a UFO conference, as where it came from. If true, it would mean the Navy was quietly collecting unexplained craft from the sea in the 1960s.
